lines.text: The LORD told Joshua to make flint knives, and Joshua circumcised the sons of Israel.
The Israelites wandered in the wilderness for forty years until all the men of war from Egypt had died.
The LORD raised up their sons in their place, and after Joshua circumcised them, they stayed in camp until healed.
The LORD rolled away the reproach of Egypt, and Israel kept the Passover at Shiloh on the plains of Jericho.
The day after the Passover they ate unleavened bread and roasted grain, and the quail ceased the day after that.
